create_nuscenes_infos: create pkl info files for nuScenes dataset from raw data with lidar sweeps and camera calibration
get_available_scenes: get a list of available scenes with valid lidar data from a nuScenes dataset object
export_2d_annotation: export 2D COCO-format bounding box annotations from nuScenes info files and raw camera data
get_2d_boxes: get 2D annotation records by projecting 3D boxes onto a camera image for a given sample data token
obtain_sensor2top: obtain the rotation and translation matrix from any sensor to the top LiDAR frame
